prd-analyzer.description: Extract and structure requirements from PRD documents (PDF, Word, Markdown, text)

figma-extractor.description: Extract screens, frames, and components from Figma design files

screen-planner.description: Plan detailed screens and wireframes based on PRD requirements

screen-validator.description: Validate screen plans against PRD requirements to ensure complete coverage

design-system-loader.description: Load and parse design system components from external sources (Figma, Markdown, URL)

component-analyzer.description: Analyze design system components for completeness against screen requirements

coverage-scorer.description: Score how well design system covers screen requirements with percentage and gap analysis

coverage-reporter.description: Generate comprehensive PDF coverage analysis report with findings and roadmap

figma-modifier.description: Auto-create and modify components in Figma based on coverage analysis gaps

run-prd-workflow.description: Run the complete PRD-to-Figma workflow end-to-end with all analyses and outputs

prd-to-figma.description: Complete workflow for PRD validation, design analysis, and component coverage scoring

FIGMA_API_TOKEN.description: Figma personal access token from https://www.figma.com/developers

DESIGN_SYSTEM_URL.description: URL to your design system (Figma file, Markdown, or external URL)

OUTPUT_FOLDER.description: Where to save generated reports and outputs

pipeline.description: Skill dependency graph + artifact contract. Any skill invoked on its own resolves and runs its prerequisites first.
